newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney files $516 mln shelf of debt.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney files $516 mln shelf of debt.

text.p: Smith Barney Holdings Inc, a unit of Travelers Group Inc, filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $516 million in debt securities.
When combined with previously registered debt, the company's shelf offering totals $1 billion.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include capital contributions to the company's subsidiaries and repaying outstanding debt.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
